act_name: Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985
purpose: To consolidate and amend the law relating to narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances, and to provide for the control and regulation of operations relating to them.
objectives: Prevent illicit trafficking of narcotic drugs and psychotropic substances
Regulate manufacture, possession, transport, sale and use for medical and scientific purposes
Provide stringent penalties for NDPS offences
Enable investigation and prosecution of drug-related crimes

key_sections.purpose: General prohibition on production, possession, sale, purchase, transport, storage, use, import and export of narcotic drugs and psychotropic substances except as permitted.
Punishment for offences involving opium and opium poppy.
Punishment for offences involving cannabis (ganja and hashish/charas).
Punishment for offences involving manufactured narcotic drugs such as heroin and cocaine.
Punishment for offences involving psychotropic substances such as MDMA and methamphetamine.
